narration.text: Why 36,000 tonnes a year barely dents CO2.
That's the capacity of the biggest air-capture plant.
Capture there costs about $1,000 per tonne.
Net zero may need 980 million tonnes a year by 2050.
That's tens of thousands of plants like it.
An earlier plant, Orca, averaged just 600 tonnes a year.
It didn't even offset its own emissions.
So air capture helps at the edges. Cutting emissions does the heavy lifting.
